way_a_reason: harbor 0.24.0 'trials regrade' re-runs the separate verifier (tests and rewardkit judge) on the saved agent/ and artifacts/, and marks the result source_trial action=regrade. Eligible only if instruction.md and environment/ are unchanged and every declared artifact is in the run manifest (schema yes; sentinel yes for a judge-only fix; cold-chain, tariff, district no). QC has no rule against it, but LEVER_RULES_v3.md:211/213 bar old-program-on-changed-bundle evidence, and tests written against one recorded run are fitted to it. Use it as a diagnostic; push needs an Ayush ruling or a new run.
way_b_reliability: LOW for margins under 20 pp: 29 recorded rounds, final went up in 10; only 2 of 17 rounds starting at tests 100 ended below 100 (both test levers); a single run is reliable only when the designed margin is at least 20 pp final and the lever is lost by blind reads
